user.title: Paste your My O2 cookies
user.description: Open https://www.o2.co.uk/ecare/home in your browser, sign in, then open DevTools → Network → click the request to ecare/home → Headers → copy the value of the `Cookie:` request header. Paste it below.

reauth_confirm.title: O2 session expired
reauth_confirm.description: Your O2 session has expired. Sign in to https://www.o2.co.uk/ecare/home again, copy the `Cookie` header from DevTools, and paste it below.

error.invalid_cookies: Couldn't reach the dashboard with these cookies. Sign in again and copy a fresh `Cookie` header.

init.title: O2 UK options
init.description: Adjust the polling interval, or paste fresh cookies to refresh the session.

data.cookies: New Cookie header (leave blank to keep the current one)

error.invalid_cookies: Couldn't reach the dashboard with the new cookies.
